No article text or PDF is in the project, so the published value is the authors' code output on the shipped data. Table 9A column (5).
notes: Table 9A column (5): U.S. sanctions and firm performance, outcome tobin_q; Chinese listed firms x year, 2007-2018 (1,981 firms, 16,247 rows, unbalanced). Authors: reg tobin_q post_sanction asset age capex_ratio ppe_ratio leverage_ratio RnD_at_ratio i.year, absorb(firm_ID) vce(robust). Controls (time-varying firm characteristics): log assets, log(1+age), capex/assets, PP&E/assets, leverage, R&D/assets; the controls rule is the only 5c violation. post_sanction = 1 if the firm's technology sector had been exposed to U.S. sanctions before that year. 606 ever-treated firms, 1,375 never treated; first-treated years 2007-2018 (2007: 111 firms). 411 ever-treated firms are treated in their first observed year (111 from 2007 plus late entrants already treated); run_spec dates late entrants to their entry year, which has no effect on TWFE, CSA or BJS because they have no untreated rows. Switch-offs: 77 firms switch back off (mostly 000000010000, the IPC-60 type exposure); run_spec drops 307 post-adoption rows with post_sanction = 0 (Hull fn 6), so the run_spec TWFE differs from the authors' coefficient. SE deviation: authors use heteroskedasticity-robust SEs; run_spec clusters by firm. Data: t9a_panel.rds = Table_9A_Data.dta plus firm_num = integer code of the zero-padded firm_ID.
